speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome with a generalized rash (noting the discrepancy regarding pneumonia, as pneumonia does not typically present as a generalized rash in newborns; the maternal history of untreated gonorrhea also raises concern for other sepsis causes, but the rash description is key).

REQUEST TEST: TORCH serology panel (Rubella, CMV, Syphilis, Toxoplasmosis, Parvovirus B19, Herpes Simplex). REQUEST TEST: Gram stain and culture of skin lesions.
